phases.description: HAL looks down at the key
HAL speaks to IRIS without looking up
HAL raises his eyes to IRIS

questions.question: Viewer reads: he thinks she will leave like her mother did - carried by: HAL
0-1.5s SETUP: does this happen on screen - HAL looks down at the key?
1.5-4.5s ACTION: does this happen on screen - HAL speaks to IRIS without looking up?
4.5-5.5s ACTION: does this happen on screen - HAL raises his eyes to IRIS?
5.5-7s HOLD: does this happen on screen - HAL holds her look?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): HAL speaks to IRIS
HAL: does the face/body read as hurt, pointed (restrained)? Must NOT read as: anger.
Line 33 is audible, spoken by the right character, lips match: HAL: Your mother said that about Leeds.
HAL sounds like the voice bible: low gravelly male voice; no reference take yet (the first accepted speaking take becomes it)
Planned size CLOSE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

First frame matches state SC03_g1: Continues from the previous shot: IRIS standing across the table, frame-left; HAL seated at the table, frame-right; the key: flat on the table in front of the empty chair; the mugs: two white mugs on the table, the second one steaming beside the key; the empty chair: pulled out from the table on the left.

Last frame matches state SC03_g2: Continues from the previous shot: IRIS standing across the table, frame-left; HAL seated at the table, frame-right; the key: flat on the table in front of the empty chair; the mugs: two white mugs on the table, the second one steaming beside the key; the empty chair: pulled out from the table on the left.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
Line 33: does HAL clearly speak to IRIS (eyes and body toward them)?
Is the place where IRIS stands kept out of frame (never shown empty), and do HAL's eyes go just past the lens to frame-left?
Does HAL look at key and never into the lens?

instructions: Fill checks[] (result, severity on FAIL, level, evidence, reviewer human:<id>), then `film.py review --film DIR --ingest FILE`. Leave a group UNASSESSED if you did not look. Questions with an id (REL_*) need a short answer in the group check's answers{id: text}; without it the take cannot be ACCEPTED.
